title: Per-role and per-agent model profile layers for the OpenRouter launch path
description: Committed at routing/profiles.json. The class -> model mapping lives in routing/capabilities.json; this file carries the layers that override it for one role or one agent, plus the session model — per provider, because the two launch paths speak different vocabularies (an OpenRouter id on the broker; a tier alias or a native claude-… id on plain claude). Resolution is a per-provider, per-key merge, nearest layer wins: capabilities.providers.<provider>.models <- defaults <- roles.<role> <- agents.<login> <- the agent's gitignored model-profile.local.json (written by bin/fabric-model). On the broker path the launcher applies the family shim (routing/shims.json) to every merged model and exports the composites under the harness aliases (runtime/claude-code/aliases.json); on plain claude it exports the merged alias bindings and the review pin reaches the reviewer's agent file. The review capability's merged model must be in routing/policies/review-grade.json on every provider. Credentials are never here. Authored by architect-cto like a charter.

model_id.description: A canonical model reference: `vendor/model`, a dated `vendor/model-YYYYMMDD`, a family alias `~vendor/family-latest`, or a router `openrouter/<router>`; an optional `:variant` suffix (floor, nitro, exacto) and an optional `[1m]` context hint. A preset is a SHIM, not a model, so `@preset/...` is not a model id here; the runtime attaches it.

profile.description: One layer of the merge. Every field is optional in a layer.

session.description: The OpenRouter form of the session: what `ori claude --model` receives (with its family shim) unless an explicit --model is given. An `anthropic/<id>` here also serves plain claude as `<id>` unless providers.anthropic.session says otherwise.

providers.description: Per-provider choices for this layer; the vocabulary differs per provider, so each has its own shape.

notes.description: Why this layer differs from the one below it — one or two sentences, for the reader of the file.

native_id.description: A native Claude id as plain `claude` names it (claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5[1m]); what a tier alias binds to when the fabric pins it.

harness_ref.description: What plain claude's --model takes: a tier alias (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) the harness binds to its current model of that tier, or a native Claude id.

openrouter_layer.description: The broker path's choices for this layer: the session and any class, as OpenRouter ids. The same as the flat `session`/`capabilities`, spelled under its provider.

openrouter_capabilities.description: Overrides of the class -> OpenRouter model mapping for this layer.

review.description: The merged value MUST be one of routing/policies/review-grade.json; lint and the launcher both refuse otherwise.

anthropic_layer.description: Plain claude's choices for this layer. `session` is what --model receives. `aliases` binds a tier alias to a native id, exported as that alias's ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL for the whole session — a coding class rides its alias (runtime/claude-code/aliases.json), so binding `opus` is how code-high is pinned here. `capabilities.review` is the reviewer's pin, applied through its agent file rather than the fable export, so a hand `/model fable` stays the hand's; it MUST be review-grade.

defaults.description: The bottom layer above capabilities.json. Must yield a session for every provider (lint checks the merge, since the flat `session` may serve both).

roles.description: Per-role layer, keyed by a role id from identities/roles/catalog.json.

agents.description: Per-agent layer, keyed by the agent's Linux login (runtime/identity.py). Never a directory or clone name.
